ticker_news.title: Billionaire Steve Mandel Just Bought $100 Million More of His Top Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stock Pick
ticker_news.description: Billionaire Steve Mandel's firm, Lone Pine Capital, has increased its stake in Meta Platforms (META) by $100 million, indicating confidence in the company's social media dominance and its investments in artificial intelligence (AI).
ticker_news.author: The Motley Fool

SPY.title: Zelensky Says Ukraine Won't Trade Minerals For Debt, Seeks 'Win-Win' Deal With US
SPY.description: Ukraine's President Zelensky remains focused on security guarantees as the country negotiates a deal with the US over its rare earth minerals. Zelensky is committed to a 'win-win' agreement and has disputed the financial claims made by the Trump administration.
SPY.author: Stjepan Kalinic
